description: The source descriptions explain irrigation management as control of the rate, amount and timing of applied water. Three crop-specific information sources address winter wheat, sugar beet and silage corn in southern Alberta. They are grouped here as a bounded family of irrigation-scheduling guidance with the same named purpose, publisher and region. The grouping does not assert that their schedules or water needs are interchangeable. The metadata lists PDF and EPUB forms; sugar-beet guidance is revised February 2012, while the silage-corn record lists a revised August 2016 document and superseded November 2012 forms. The winter-wheat edition date is not stated by its descriptor. Numerical schedules, crop coefficients and a specific simulation application are not exposed in the inspected metadata. Full descriptive metadata and original package identifiers are available through the Canadian Urban Data Catalogue. It labels these sources Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and actual document access are not stated or tested. No document body was fetched. Related editions and component representations are retained together; the technical contents and fitness for a particular model remain unverified.
